open AlgebraicGeometry Adelic

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne X]
    [Algebra k X.functionField] [IsConstantField k X] (U₀ U₁ : X.Opens)

theorem iter {U : X.Opens} {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U)
    (E : X.WeilDivisor) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    sectionSub k U (n • pointDivisor P + E) = sectionSub k U E := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      have e : ((m+1) • pointDivisor P + E) = pointDivisor P + (m • pointDivisor P + E) := by
        rw [succ_nsmul]; abel
      rw [e, sectionSub_add_pointDivisor_of_notMem k U hP, ih]

/-- **χ is BOUNDED along the tower `n·P + E` at an off-`U₀` prime**, by the file's own
formula: `S₀` and `𝒜` are frozen and `S₁(n·P+E) ≤ 𝒜(n·P+E) = 𝒜(E)`. -/
theorem chi_bounded_along_tower (hcov : U₀ ⊔ U₁ = ⊤)
    {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U₀) (E : X.WeilDivisor)
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₀ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₁ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k (U₀ ⊓ U₁) D)]
    (n : ℕ) :
    chi k U₀ U₁ (n • pointDivisor P + E) ≤ Module.finrank k (sectionSub k U₀ E) := by
  have hPinf : P.point ∉ (U₀ ⊓ U₁ : X.Opens) := fun h => hP h.1
  have h := chi_eq_charts_sub_overlap k U₀ U₁ hcov (n • pointDivisor P + E)
  have hle : sectionSub k U₁ (n • pointDivisor P + E)
      ≤ sectionSub k (U₀ ⊓ U₁) (n • pointDivisor P + E) :=
    sectionSub_antitone_open k inf_le_right _
  have hmono := Submodule.finrank_mono (R := k) hle
  rw [iter k hP E n, iter k hPinf E n] at h
  omega

/-- **`hbump` is FALSE at every off-`U₀` prime — unconditionally.** -/
theorem hbump_refuted_off_chart (hcov : U₀ ⊔ U₁ = ⊤)
    {P : X.PrimeDivisor} (hP : P.point ∉ U₀)
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₀ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k U₁ D)]
    [∀ D : X.WeilDivisor, Module.Finite k (sectionSub k (U₀ ⊓ U₁) D)]
    [Module.Finite k (localStepTgt k P 1)]
    (hbump : ∀ (Q : X.PrimeDivisor) (E : X.WeilDivisor),
      chi k U₀ U₁ (pointDivisor Q + E) = chi k U₀ U₁ E + residueDeg k Q) :
    False := by
  have grow : ∀ n : ℕ, chi k U₀ U₁ (n • pointDivisor P + (0 : X.WeilDivisor))
      = chi k U₀ U₁ (0 : X.WeilDivisor) + n * residueDeg k P := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
        have e : ((m+1) • pointDivisor P + (0 : X.WeilDivisor))
            = pointDivisor P + (m • pointDivisor P + (0 : X.WeilDivisor)) := by
          rw [succ_nsmul]; abel
        rw [e, hbump P, ih]; push_cast; ring
  have h1 : 1 ≤ residueDeg k P := one_le_residueDeg k P
  set B : ℤ := (Module.finrank k (sectionSub k U₀ (0 : X.WeilDivisor)) : ℤ) with hB
  set c : ℤ := chi k U₀ U₁ (0 : X.WeilDivisor) with hc
  -- pick n = (B - c + 1).toNat
  have hbd := chi_bounded_along_tower k U₀ U₁ hcov hP (0 : X.WeilDivisor) (B - c + 1).toNat
  rw [grow] at hbd
  have hcast : (((B - c + 1).toNat : ℕ) : ℤ) = max (B - c + 1) 0 := by
    simp [Int.toNat_eq_max]
  rw [hcast] at hbd
  rcases le_or_lt (B - c + 1) 0 with hneg | hpos
  · rw [max_eq_right hneg] at hbd; omega
  · rw [max_eq_left hpos.le] at hbd
    nlinarith [hbd, h1, hpos]
EOF
